resources.string: Keeps working when you close the app.
Ready for every connection. Protect your display automatically, even after restarting your Odin.
On · ready for your next connection
On · tap Start protection to resume

1. Start protection or turn on Auto protect. 2. Connect your Retroid Dual Screen. 3. Wait for Protected, then return to your launcher.
Protection keeps running when you swipe OdinDuo away from recent apps and during sleep.
Auto protect stays ready between connections and resumes after a restart. Stop protection turns Auto protect off too.
Keeping the connected USB display awake may use extra battery. Unplugging or stopping restores normal USB power management.
After Android’s Force stop or its Active apps Stop, open OdinDuo again to resume.
Built for AYN Odin 3 and Retroid Dual Screen. No root installation needed.
